items.title: LangChain reorganizes LangSmith around registered agent records

items.title: AWS SageMaker adds cache-aware routing for real-time endpoints
notes: The AWS source explicitly gives 17 November 2026.

items.title: AWS HyperPod Inference adds managed NVIDIA Dynamo deployments
problems: Before: Teams built and operated distributed Dynamo serving components, pod placement and node recovery on Kubernetes. | The sources describe the HyperPod add-on and Dynamo as distributed inference software, but do not state that teams previously built those components in this way.
notes: The AWS source explicitly gives 17 November 2026.
The AWS source supports the managed add-on, disaggregated serving, KV-aware routing and node replacement.

items.title: GitHub adds Copilot Evals for skills, agents and MCP tools
problems: Before: Copilot users had ad hoc results but no packaged repeat-run workflow. | The source describes the new repeatable eval workflow but says nothing explicit about the prior workflow.
notes: The GitHub source explicitly gives November 17, 2026 and confirms public preview availability.

items.title: GitHub streams Copilot agent activity into Microsoft Agent 365
problems: Before: GitHub Copilot activity stayed mainly in GitHub audit systems and Microsoft Agent 365 lacked a single view of Copilot sessions. | The source announces the new streaming capability but does not state or confirm the prior audit-system or Agent 365 state.
notes: The GitHub source explicitly gives November 17, 2026 and confirms Enterprise Managed Users can stream activity.
